data.name: Juwariyah
data.gender_notes: Juwariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Juwariyah means 'ornamented' or 'adorned one'. It is derived from the word 'Jawhar' which means 'gemstone' or 'jewel'. The name Juwariyah carries the meaning “Adorned one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Juwariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody adorned one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying grace and beauty, Juwariyah serves as a reminder of the inner and outer adornments Allah has bestowed upon us.
data.etymology: Juwariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adorned one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwariyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
